More homes for sale, fewer sales closed.

The Texas Real Estate Research Center’s November 20 report shows the Austin–Round Rock–San Marcos metro ended September with 14,054 active listings, up 3.9% from a year earlier. The metro recorded 2,538 sales that month, down 3.9%. Even with that September dip, sales through the first nine months were up 6.6% from the same stretch in 2025.

Shopping this fall? Look at the homes you could buy today and the comparable sales that actually closed. If you’re selling, those active listings are your competition.

Source: Texas Real Estate Research Center, Texas Housing Insight, November 20, 2026.
